evidence.claim: MKS designs and manufactures instruments, subsystems, systems, process-control solutions and specialty chemicals focused on vacuum, photonics, lasers and related technologies for semiconductor manufacturing and other markets.

MKS reported that its Vacuum Solutions Division revenue increased in 2025, mainly due to higher semiconductor capital equipment sales in logic and foundry applications, NAND memory upgrades and service revenue.
A 2025 MKS filing stated that its semiconductor market offering is the broadest critical-subsystem provider in the wafer-fabrication-equipment ecosystem and addresses over 85% of the market.
Advanced Energy sells advanced and system power products and services to global OEMs, distributors and end customers, with semiconductor equipment listed as one of its markets.
Advanced Energy describes itself as addressing power demands in the semiconductor sector for more than forty years and supplying mission-critical high-voltage equipment for demanding applications.
Ichor's primary products include gas and chemical delivery systems and subsystems, described as key elements of process tools used in semiconductor-device manufacturing.

Ichor disclosed that once a system, subsystem, component or instrument is incorporated into capital equipment, it often continues to be purchased for that equipment on an exclusive basis for 18 to 24 months before an OEM considers alternatives.

Ichor's 2026 filing summary states that it operates one segment focused on design, engineering and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components for semiconductor capital equipment.

Entegris is a supplier of critical advanced materials and process solutions for semiconductor and other high-technology industries, with disclosed capacity additions in liquid filtration, deposition materials, materials handling, CMP filters and slurries, SiC slurries and solid precursors.
Entegris products include filtration for aggressive acid and base chemistries, ultra-pure-water filtration, liquid purifier/filter products, gas microcontamination control and EUV reticle pods.
As of June 11, 2026, the web finance snapshot showed MKS Instruments with an approximately $22.47 billion market capitalization.
As of June 11, 2026, the web finance snapshot showed Advanced Energy Industries with an approximately $13.00 billion market capitalization.
As of June 11, 2026, the web finance snapshot showed Ichor Holdings with an approximately $2.50 billion market capitalization.
As of June 11, 2026, the web finance snapshot showed Entegris with an approximately $19.74 billion market capitalization.

memory_update.text: ICHR should be promoted as the primary underfollowed small/mid-cap candidate for the semicap subsystem node because its disclosed product set directly maps to gas and chemical delivery subsystems for semiconductor capital equipment OEMs.

MKSI remains the key reference anchor for the node despite larger market cap because it spans vacuum, RF/power, flow, pressure, process control and specialty chemicals, and external context/filings indicate broad penetration across wafer-fab-equipment subsystems.

Qualification lock-in is explicitly visible in Ichor disclosures: after incorporation into capital equipment, certain systems/subsystems/components may continue to be purchased exclusively for 18 to 24 months before alternative suppliers are considered.

Need further US-listed discovery for niche vacuum-valve, mass-flow-controller, metrology, motion-control, plating-chemistry and subsystem-testing suppliers. Current pass found strong US-listed candidates in power delivery, fluid delivery, contamination control and broad subsystems, but fewer pure-play public names in vacuum valves and mass-flow controllers.

node: Semiconductor equipment subsystems embedded inside OEM fab tools
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the underfollowed semicap subsystem layer. The strongest direct matches are suppliers of RF/DC power, vacuum/process control, gas and chemical delivery, fluid delivery, filtration, contamination-control and related subsystems that are embedded in OEM wafer-fabrication tools. This pass keeps larger reference names only where exposure is unusually pure, while emphasizing Ichor as the cleaner small/mid-cap discovery candidate.
